text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Grass Wonder runs a picture-perfect race, it doesn't clear her reputation as Maruzensky's successor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets her sights on a direct clash with Maruzensky to break free of the association once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she needs to build up experience in the Classics first to make it a reality. The Japanese Derby becomes our next goal.
